primary_meaning: The body of Christ (Eucharistic presence and sacrificial life given for believers)

alternatives.meaning: God's daily provision and physical/spiritual sustenance (manna typology)
The Word of God as true life-giving sustenance
Christian fellowship and communal unity (breaking of bread)
Hospitality, covenant meal, or simple human sustenance without deeper christological overlay

notes: Across historic Christian teaching the Eucharistic identification of bread with Christ's body (and the related Bread of Life discourse) is the dominant and most widely attested symbolic reading; other senses remain common but secondary or complementary rather than competitive.
